title: Two muscle samples
body: A sports scientist compares two samples of skeletal muscle taken from different muscles of the same athlete. Sample X looks deep red. Under the microscope its fibres contain a large amount of an oxygen-storing pigment and plenty of mitochondria. Sample Y looks pale or whitish. Its fibres contain very little of the pigment and few mitochondria, but a large amount of sarcoplasmic reticulum. When both muscles are stimulated repeatedly in the laboratory, sample X keeps contracting for a long time, while sample Y contracts strongly at first but soon shows fatigue.
